name: PSPDX

### ✨ New

- **Errors stay on screen.** A failure waits for X, with a small line under it to show us in a photo.
- **Set up USBNet** under the gear: connect over the USB cable at any time, not only at the first start.
- **One file.** The PSPDX folder holds just EBOOT.PBP; the font and the USB plugin are inside it.

### 🛠 Fixed

- PSPDX shows under its source again.
- No more updates offered for an app that was just installed.
- Updates are found even when the PSP's date is wrong.
- Several plugins from INBOX: each one is asked about.

### ✅ Tested

100 runs on a real PSP-1000 (6.60 + ARK), all passed:
- 25× first start over the USB cable until online
- 25× USBNet install, on, off, delete
- 25× install and delete an app from GitHub
- 15× Run an installed app
- 10× start with the built-in font

The font also in PPSSPP without firmware fonts.

Extract `pspdx.zip` to your PSP storage, or update through PSPDX.

### 🛠 Fixed

- **Start apps from PSPDX.** "Run" and the restart after an update did nothing in 1.1.0 to 1.1.3. Both work again, from the Memory Stick and from the PSP Go's System Storage.

Tested on PSP Go (6.60 + ARK).

### ✨ New

- **Online over the USB cable.** No Wi-Fi needed: choose "USB cable" at the first start and PSPDX sets up [USBNet](https://github.com/chriopter/pspkit-usbnet) for you.
- **PSPDX finds the gateway.** It looks for the gateway on your PC and tells you where to get it if it is not running.
- **Plugins.** Install, turn on and off, update and delete plugins right from the store.
- **Faster downloads.** Up to twice as fast on a PSP Go.

### 🛠 Fixed

- **Run works again.** In 1.1.0 to 1.1.2 starting an app from PSPDX, and the restart after an update, did nothing.

Tested on PSP-1000 and PSP Go (6.60 + ARK).

Fixes the "PSPDX failed / font: nothing loadable" startup error in PPSSPP when flash0 font access fails.

- Ships a free replacement font beside EBOOT.PBP and loads it when firmware fonts are unavailable.
- Keeps firmware fonts as the first choice on real PSP hardware.
- Includes the font in the release package and development launchers, with source and license information.

Validation: PSP build, 156 client tests with address/undefined-behavior sanitizers, schema checks, and a successful PPSSPP 1.20.4 launch on a fresh Memory Stick without a debug font override.

Extract pspdx.zip into your PSP or PPSSPP Memory Stick directory, preserving the full package.

**PSPDX 1.0 is here: find, install and update homebrew right on your PSP. No PC, no cable.**

![A tour of PSPDX, real footage from a PSP-1004](https://github.com/chriopter/pspdx-app/releases/download/v1.0.0/pspdx-tour.webp)

[▶ Watch in full quality](https://github.com/chriopter/pspdx-app/releases/download/v1.0.0/pspdx-tour.mp4) · real footage from a PSP-1004

### ⭐ What PSPDX does

- **About 1,750 apps in one list.** The whole pspdev catalog plus community sources, newest first. Add your own sources too.
- **Browse your way.** By category, by tag in a tag cloud, or by source, with app icons as a preview.
- **See before you install.** Screenshots and short films of the apps, right on the card.
- **Install with one button.** PSPDX downloads, checks and unpacks the app to your Memory Stick.
- **Background downloads.** Keep browsing while apps download and install.
- **Basket.** Collect several apps and get them all at once.
- **Updates in one press.** PSPDX shows what is new, for your apps and for itself. Saves and settings stay.
- **Safe.** Every download is verified, and an install cut off by a power loss is rolled back. Tested automatically on real hardware: hours of scripted browsing, downloads, installs and updates on a PSP-1000.
- **Works offline.** The catalog and pictures are kept, so browsing works without Wi-Fi.

### 📊 Download speeds

Previous PSP Go measurements: the same 1,672,559-byte ZIP, three transfers per mode. Includes TLS/redirects, internal-storage writes and SHA-256 verification.

| Mode | Throughput | Time per download |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Baked UI / 30 FPS, background | 1.40 Mbit/s | 9.55 s |
| Merciful UI / 60 FPS, background | 1.95 Mbit/s | 6.86 s |
| No UI drawing | 2.74 Mbit/s | 4.89 s |

The UI modes use different effects, so this does not isolate the FPS limit. No UI drawing is a benchmark baseline, not the focused progress screen. Focus-mode throughput in 0.8.4 has not been remeasured. Rates use decimal Mbit/s and vary with WLAN and server conditions.

PSP build, 145 host tests and queue/settings checks passed. Started in PPSSPP.

Includes changes from 0.5, 0.6 and 0.7.

### ✨ New

- Install and update apps without a `.pspdx`, using catalog entries or GitHub releases.
- UTF-8 text and full, scrollable descriptions.
- Exact release pinning and SHA-256 verification for non-GitHub apps.

### 🔄 Updated

- Updates preserve saves and settings; only files included in the ZIP are replaced.
- Catalogs without `schema` are accepted as v1. Installed apps keep their existing folders.
- Free-space checks before download and extraction; large images are scaled down.
- pspkit-https 0.2.2 with a 120-second fetch timeout.
- Moved to `chriopter/pspdx-app`; the old app entry is cleaned up on first start.

### 🐛 Fixed

- Crashes with long descriptions, missing non-ASCII text and invalid metadata handling.
- Folder conflicts, stalled recovery and deletion of PSPDX's own folder.
- Duplicate entries, inconsistent update checks, INBOX handling and misleading network errors.

### ✨ New

- Support for the v1 `.pspdx` and catalog formats, including tags, app types and release lists.
- Preset catalogs added once; removed presets stay removed.
- External app listings and substitute manifests (replaced in 0.8.0).

### 🔄 Updated

- Update detection uses the installed ZIP's SHA-256, with date comparison for older records.
- Gzip catalog transfers and smaller manifest allocations.
- HTTPS moved to pspkit-https with Mozilla's root certificates.
- Unknown metadata fields are ignored; longer names and descriptions are supported.
- Revised water animation and published JSON schemas.

### 🐛 Fixed

- Path buffer overflow and unterminated host strings.
- Folder claims by non-installable apps, missing error logs and schema validation mismatches.
- App-name truncation and unstable short-wave animation.

PSPDX 0.3 cannot read the new catalog. To upgrade, extract `pspdx.zip` to the Memory Stick manually.

### ✨ New - Ambient music and button sounds. - Manage Data for sources, installed apps, INBOX and system files, with cached media previews. - Quick catalog checks, full repository checks and catalog age indicators. - Self-updates without a catalog and a restart prompt after updating. - Confirmation before connecting with an expired or unknown-issuer certificate. ### 🔄 Updated - App actions, scrolling long names, Reset and Clear Cache options. - wolfSSL 5.9.2, TLS connection reuse and text-list fallback for catalog URLs. ### 🐛 Fixed - Removal of apps with long paths, interrupted-install recovery and stale temporary files. - Conflicting install records, invalid catalogs and case-sensitive self-update paths. - Certificate date checks, TLS seed renewal and missing settings rows. ### 🎥 Demo

### ✨ New

- App metadata stored in each repository's `.pspdx` and retained after installation.
- Updates without a catalog, additional catalog/repository sources and INBOX installs.
- Automatic recovery of interrupted installations.

### 🔄 Updated

- XMB-style controls and settings for sources, direct installs, updates and reset.
- Native-size videos, idle background images and media loaded from installed EBOOTs.

### 🐛 Fixed

- Black boxes behind text and icons.
- Failed installations blocking subsequent installs.
- Image resizing when video starts and audio interruptions during scrolling.
- Development builds incorrectly offering an older release as an update.

### ✨ New

- Browse, install and update PSP homebrew from a catalog.
- TLS 1.3 downloads with certificate verification and SHA-256 package checks.
- App update checks and PSPDX self-updates.
- Category tabs, updates view and cart.
- Animated backgrounds, music, app icons and video previews.
- Connection status and offline retry.

### 🐛 Fixed

- Media request race condition.
- Socket connections waiting for the full timeout.
- Abrupt transitions in the water animation.
